stories.title: Correct ExternalProvider type; add manifest field validation
stories.description: ExternalProvider -> ado|jira|other (matches ARC-011 + both prompts, not the stale azure-devops|github|gitlab|jira). readManifest rejects unsupported tracking_mode/external_provider values via new ManifestInvalidFieldError (D2).
acceptanceCriteria: readManifest throws ManifestInvalidFieldError for an unsupported tracking_mode or external_provider value
readManifest accepts external_provider: null and accepts the field being absent entirely
stories.testEvidence: test/manifest.test.ts: 9 new cases (bad tracking_mode, bad/stale external_provider value, external_provider: null accepted, both fields absent accepted, parameterized accept-cases for all 2 tracking_mode and all 3 external_provider valid values). Full manifest.test.ts: 31/32 passing (1 pre-existing POSIX-only skip). tsc --noEmit clean.

stories.title: spell init asks/defaults tracking_mode once, persists it
stories.description: New Step 5b in init.ts, per D5/D6: governance-only/methodology profiles get a silent internal/null default (even scripted); full/lite ask once interactively (Track work in this repo vs an external tracker; if external, which provider); full/lite scripted (--profile) leaves it unset for later retrofit.
acceptanceCriteria: governance-only and methodology profiles write tracking_mode: internal, external_provider: null with no question, including under --profile
full/lite interactive: asks once with D6's wording, persists the answer (and provider, if external)
full/lite with --profile: no question asked, tracking_mode left unset
stories.testEvidence: test/hub-retrofit.test.ts new 'spell init — tracking mode (EF-14)' suite: 5/5 passing (governance-only silent default, methodology silent default, lite --profile leaves unset, lite interactive internal branch, lite interactive external+jira branch). select() converted to a hoisted, message-branching mock (selectMock) shared with the existing hub-question tests, which continue to pass unmodified (12/12). Full file: 21/21 passing. tsc --noEmit clean.

stories.title: spell update backfills tracking_mode via MANIFEST_RETROFITS
stories.description: ManifestRetrofit.ask gains a manifest parameter (D4). New tracking_mode retrofit entry mirrors init's D5 branching exactly, reachable from spell update for installs that predate the field.
acceptanceCriteria: needsRetrofit is true only when tracking_mode is undefined
ask(manifest) applies the same governance-only/methodology silent default, or asks for full/lite
idempotent: a second update with tracking_mode already set asks nothing
stories.testEvidence: Same suite, 'spell update — manifest retrofit wizard' + 'MANIFEST_RETROFITS registry': 4 new cases (governance-only silent backfill, lite interactive backfill with external+ado, idempotent no-ask once set, needsRetrofit true/false coverage). ManifestRetrofit.ask signature change (adds manifest param) verified compatible with the existing role entry, which ignores it -- role's own 3 pre-existing tests still pass unchanged.

stories.title: spell-open-session / spell-plan resolve tracking config from the manifest before asking
stories.description: open-session: add the missing self-hosted-source-manifest fallback tier (root .arcane.json -> src/assets/.arcane.json when selfHosted -> PRD frontmatter -> ask), fixing the live contradiction with EF-14's own recorded resolution order. plan: add the resolution chain that currently doesn't exist at all, plus an explicit ask-instruction.
acceptanceCriteria: spell-open-session.prompt.md documents reading src/assets/.arcane.json's tracking_mode/external_provider when selfHosted is true and root .arcane.json is absent
spell-plan.prompt.md's 'Configure tracking mode first' step reads .arcane.json (currently absent) before falling through to asking
Both files state concrete question wording (Track work in this repo / an external tracker) rather than only raw enum tokens

stories.title: EF-08: five files resolve {BUSINESS_ROOT} instead of hardcoding ventures/
stories.description: spell-check-drift, spell-commit-work, spell-open-session, spell-plan, spell-todo -- ungated {BUSINESS_ROOT} resolution (D8), matching spell-present-arcane/spell-product-review's existing non-hub-gated idiom exactly (spell-summon-venture's hub-gated version doesn't apply -- these five run in any repo).
acceptanceCriteria: No literal top-level ventures/ remains in a resolution-instruction or user-facing-label context in any of the five files
Each of the five states the {BUSINESS_ROOT} resolution sentence (from .arcane.json's business_root field, default ventures/ if unset)

stories.title: New ADR amending ARC-020; EF-14/EF-08 shipped; version bump
stories.description: New ARC-0XX (Amends: ARC-020, ARC-020 itself untouched/still Proposed), per D2/D3. EF-14.md and EF-08.md frontmatter -> shipped. TODO.md/CHANGELOG.md updated. package.json minor bump (0.17.0 -- feature-sized, not patch, matching the plan's own categorization).
acceptanceCriteria: New ADR's Status is Accepted with an explicit Amends: ARC-020 header; ARC-020's own Status remains Proposed, unedited
